subject.title: feat(agents): agent-controlled session status, attention, and TTL in the sessions tool

question: Should OpenClaw make agent-declared transient status and attention a permanent core sessions-tool contract, alongside the already merged automatic attention and live narration layers?
rationale: The implementation is a new model-facing capability with persisted session-state semantics; tests can verify mechanics but cannot establish the intended product authority or policy for agent-controlled sidebar attention.

options.title: Sponsor the core contract
options.body: Accept agent-declared transient status as a core sessions-tool capability after real lifecycle proof confirms it clears safely.

options.title: Keep attention automatic only
options.body: Retain the existing question, approval, failure, and narration behavior and decline a new agent-declared session-state layer.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core contract
recommendation.body: Accept agent-declared transient status as a core sessions-tool capability after real lifecycle proof confirms it clears safely.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership of the adjacent automatic-attention and narration implementations makes this the strongest available routing candidate.
